Common questions

Are the law mock tests on The Lawverse India free?

Yes. Over 100 mock tests with more than 6,900 questions are free to attempt on this page, with instant answers and explanations.

Which exams do the mock tests help with?

They help with judiciary and APO exams such as RJPO and Raj APO, AIBE, UGC NET Law and law entrance exams like CLAT.

Which subjects are covered?

BNS, IPC, BNSS, CrPC, Evidence Act and BSA, Arms Act, SC/ST Act, Juvenile Justice Act, POCSO Act, Probation of Offenders Act, Rajasthan Excise Act and the Rajasthan Public Examination Act.

Is there a Hindi medium mock test?

Yes. A full mock test in Hindi medium is available in the Free mock tests section.

How can I contact The Lawverse India?

Call 91714 65753 or 91096 21404, or use the contact form on this page. You can also follow the channel on YouTube and Instagram.
